verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar is a SaaS service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. The probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, which Radar users can connect an agent to. Evidence is limited to that single probe line, and the server is Stripe-wide rather than Radar-specific. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MCP server exposes Radar-specific tools (reviews, rules, value lists, early fraud warnings), in-depth setup/auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
